blurb: Guests rent various boats including pontoons, surf boats, family boats, jet skis, and yachts to explore Okanagan and Kalamalka Lakes. Rentals include options for half-day and full-day durations, with some captained services available. The company offers online booking and provides safety gear and instructions.
